SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName,
pAgg.paymentKey,
pAgg.hanFee, pAgg.bookFee, pAgg.hanMaterial, pAgg.bookMaterial,
pAgg.totalFee, pAgg.totalMaterialFee,
(pAgg.totalFee - ISNULL(paidEdu.paidEduAmount, 0)) AS unpaidEduAmount, (pAgg.totalMaterialFee - ISNULL(paidMat.paidMatAmount, 0)) AS unpaidMaterialAmount,
pAgg.totalStatus,
hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher,
(a.parent_tel_first + a.parent_tel_middle + a.parent_tel_last) AS parentPhone,
subj.subject,
bill.eduStatus, bill.materialStatus, bill.billId
FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_parent a ON s.student_id = a.student_id
JOIN ( SELECT p.student_id, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, p.status AS totalStatus,
MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 1 AND d.item_type = 'edu_fee' THEN d.amount END) AS hanFee, MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 2 AND d.item_type = 'edu_fee' THEN d.amount END) AS bookFee,
MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 1 AND d.item_type = 'book_fee' THEN d.amount END) AS hanMaterial, MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 2 AND d.item_type = 'book_fee' THEN d.amount END) AS bookMaterial,
MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 1 THEN d.user_code END) AS hanUserCode, MAX(CASE WHEN d.class_type = 2 THEN d.user_code END) AS bookUserCode,
SUM(CASE WHEN d.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalFee, SUM(CASE WHEN d.item_type = 'BOOK_FEE' THEN d.amount ELSE 0 END) AS totalMaterialFee
FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_detail d ON p.payment_key = d.payment_key WHERE p.yy = #{year} AND p.mm = #{month} GROUP BY p.student_id, p.payment_key, p.status ) pAgg ON pAgg.student_id = s.student_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_key, SUM(amount) AS paidEduAmount FROM ( SELECT payment_key, amount FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE status = 'approved' AND bill_type IN ('edu', 'EDU_FEE') )t GROUP BY payment_key ) paidEdu ON paidEdu.payment_key = pAgg.paymentKey
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_key, SUM(amount) AS paidMatAmount FROM ( SELECT payment_key, amount FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE status = 'approved' AND bill_type IN ('material', 'BOOK_FEE') ) t GROUP BY payment_key ) paidMat ON paidMat.payment_key = pAgg.paymentKey
LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON pAgg.hanUserCode = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON pAgg.bookUserCode = bu.user_code
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT edu.status AS eduStatus, mat.status AS materialStatus, COALESCE(edu.bill_id, mat.bill_id) AS billId FROM ( SELECT TOP 1 bill_id, status FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE payment_key = pAgg.paymentKey AND bill_type IN ('edu', 'EDU_FEE') ORDER BY created_at DESC ) edu FULL OUTER JOIN ( SELECT TOP 1 bill_id, status FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE payment_key = pAgg.paymentKey AND bill_type IN ('material', 'BOOK_FEE') ORDER BY created_at DESC ) mat ON 1 = 1 ) bill
OUTER APPLY ( SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ', ' + c.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON c.class_key = CASE WHEN t.class_key = 'COM' THEN ta.class_key ELSE t.class_key END WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND c.class_type IN (1, 2) AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month}
AND t.user_code = #{userCode}
FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS subject ) subj
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code WHERE ta.student_id = s.student_id AND t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND u.center_code = #{centerCode}
AND t.user_code = #{userCode}
) ORDER BY s.student_name ASC

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code where p.status NOT IN ('approved') AND p.center_code = #{centerCode} AND p.yy = #{yy} AND p.mm = #{mm}

SELECT pb.id, pb.payment_key, pb.bill_id, pb.bill_type, pb.amount, pb.student_id, pb.center_code, pb.status, pb.created_at, pb.issued_date, pb.yy, pb.mm FROM erp_payment_bill pb JOIN (SELECT payment_key, bill_type FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE status = 'issued' GROUP BY payment_key, bill_type HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) d ON pb.payment_key = d.payment_key AND pb.bill_type = d.bill_type WHERE pb.status = 'issued' AND pb.created_at < (SELECT MAX(x.created_at) FROM erp_payment_bill x WHERE x.payment_key = pb.payment_key AND x.bill_type = pb.bill_type) ORDER BY pb.payment_key, pb.bill_type, pb.created_at;
